en: The postcard features a dramatic landscape with a large building complex, possibly a monastery or castle, atop a high, rocky hill with multiple levels of vineyards or terraced fields. A river curves gracefully through a verdant valley below, accompanied by a railway line and scattered houses. The distant landscape is characterized by gently rolling hills and rural farmland. Some handwritten or printed text can be seen at the top of the card, partially obscured.
